legs.note: GREEN at the Task-2 base => regression guard. What it guards: a row whose source.layerId ('layer-gone') no live layer owns still loads — activateAndLoad('b') resolves true, replaceClipboard received the runtime script exactly once, status 'Loaded B — 1 brushes'. This is the REACHABLE scope-unknown case; the literal 'pre-provenance script' leg is vacuous (see vacuous[0]).

vacuous.reason: A script without a provenance layer id cannot exist as a valid row. The durable schema is v1 on both sides and required source.layerId from the start: Rust validate_source requires non-empty layerId/layerName (app/src-tauri/src/services/script_library.rs:2130-2136) and a file lacking them scans as invalid-managed-script, counted in skippedInvalidCount (script_library.rs:1995-2002); TS PersistedRotoScriptSourceV1 declares layerId: string; layerName: string (app/src/components/physic-paint/roto/physicsPaintRotoScriptSchema.ts:29-38) and the runtime mapping writes provenance.layerId = document.source.layerId (:147). The literal leg was therefore NOT simulated with a hand-built row; the reachable scope-unknown case is the ORPHAN (a layerId no live layer owns), covered by L5.

refutedReconClaims.claim: The layer binding lives in the apply target resolution: prepareRotoScriptTargetRef returns null when source.layerId !== launch.layerId (CONTEXT.md recon finding 3).
refutedReconClaims.evidence: app/src/components/physic-paint/PhysicsPaintStudio.tsx:1639-1644 reads `source.layerId !== launch.layerId`, but `source` is the LIVE source snapshot (built with layerId: launchContext?.layerId), so the term compares the launch against itself — a live-source consistency check, i.e. a tautology. No origin-layer gate exists on the read path or the apply path; L2 above proves the clipboard commits to whatever destination prepareTarget resolved.
refutedReconClaims.consequence: There is no origin gate to remove. The work is to make the DESTINATION explicit and the ORIGIN cosmetic.
